body.message:
Hi, I understand that maybe there were no cockroaches when the apartment was previously visited. However, yesterday when I moved in with your colleague, we already saw several. Since then, I have continued to see more, and I have sent you photos of some that I killed.

I cannot live in these conditions. Today, you have sent a professional, which I appreciate. My question is: will there be a follow-up visit in 3–4 days to treat any eggs and ensure the infestation is fully eliminated?
